title: Analog channel configured for 0-20 mA instead of 4-20 mA
summary: A 4-20 mA level transmitter reads about 20 % high at low levels: the analog channel is configured for 0-20 mA.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: A 4-20 mA level transmitter reads about 20 % high at low levels: the analog channel is configured for 0-20 mA.

troubleshooting.effect: Wrong engineering value, false high alarms
symptoms: The level reads about 20 % with an empty tank
Readings agree near full scale but not near zero
evidence: Loop current measured at the terminal
Channel measurement type in the hardware configuration
diagnosticMethod: Measure the loop current and calculate the expected percentage
Compare with the raw value and the scaling
repair: Configure the channel for 4-20 mA and download the hardware configuration
Verify at 4, 12 and 20 mA if possible
troubleshooting.explanation: With a 0-20 mA range, 4 mA is converted as 20 % of the range. The transmitter is correct; the configuration interprets the current differently.
